tei:div.tei:p: 105)༄༅/ dbang chen rdo rje gro lod kyi sgo nas 'phang ba zor gyi las rim gnam lcags thog mda' bzhugs/ 106) ༄༅/

dam bca' gsum ldan brgya byin rdo rje'i mtshon// nyes byed lha min klad par bsnyil ba bzhin// srid gsum zla bral ldog med gnam lcags thog /srid rtsa'i snying la 'bebs pa'i mgon des skyongs// bka' gter zab rgu kun gyi phul// mkha' 'gro'i snying khrag rlangs ma phal// kun mkhyen bla mas legs byin pa'i// zab lam bcud 'di'i zur 'debs spro// de la spyi don rnam pa gsum// sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo// dang po ma dul gzhi yin na// sa ni blang dang gzung ba gces// skyang nul khrag chen gyis byugs la// bdud rtsi lnga yis chag chag 'dab// srid pa ru log mtshon pa yi// ma traṃ mgo bo lho nub dang*// rkang pa byang shar bstan pa'i steng*// lto bamathing nag gru gsum la// zla gam mdzes ris gsum dang ldan// de'i phyir rtsibs bzhi rdo rwa dang*// me ris bskor ba bris pa'i khar// ldeng khrir dug 107) khrag gis sbrus pa'i// dpal gyi gtor chen 'khor bcu bzhi// mtheb kyu sha dum rgyu ma dang*// mtshe yungs rtsang gis brgyan pa bkod// mtha' mar ri rgyud 'dre can dang*// phung sa bsres pa'i kong zor ni// brgya tsho bcu gcig grangs ldan la// brag nag mtshe dang thog lcags phye// dur khrod yungs kar mi bsad rdo// skyer mda' ltas ngan sgro bsdebs la// gri lcags mde'u gnam bstan gzug /mdor na zor rdzas bye brag rnams// zor gyi 'khor bzhin tshogs par bya// hom khung nang du zag rdzas dang*// ldan ba'i ling ga byad du gzhug /kun gyi mtha' mar rgab dkris bya// drag po'i mchod gtor nyer spyod bshams// spyi don gnyis pa dngos gzhi las// sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes dang gsum// dang po sngon 'gro rnam grangs bcu/ thog mar gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ 108)/ tshig bdun gsol 'debs rtsa ba dang*/ brgyud pa'i bla mar gsol ba gdab// gnyis pa dkar gtor gtong ba ni// kun mkhyen bla ma'i gsung rgyun la/

oṃ badz+ra ma hā shri he ru kony+rahaṃ/ bdag nyid rdo rje khro bo'i skur gyur/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rum̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ ā:hūm̐/ lan gsum gyi sadakar bgegs gnyis ka brlabs te/ bhu mi pa ti sa pā ri wa ra badz+ra sa mā dza/ s+tha na pa ti k+ṣe ṭa pa lañtsa na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo= sogs lan gsum/ gang dag 'dir gnas lha dang klu// gnod sbyin srin po'am gzhan dag la// dkyil 'khor don du sa phyogs 'di// bdag zhu khyed kyis stsal du gsol// zhes gsol la dkar gtor gshegs/ bhu mi pa ti ya hi gats+tsha/ gnyis pa bgegs gtor gtong ba ni/ sarba bhu ta 109) a kar ṣa ya dza: sarba bigh+nan na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo= sogs lan gsum gyis bsngos la/ gsum pa bgegs la bka' bsgo ba ni/ hūm̐ hrī: 'khrul pa gzung 'dzin rtog ngan rgyu: sogs nas/ ma dad sems can smos ci dgos: zhes pa'i bar dang sum bha ni'i// drag sngags thun bcas rdeg par bya// bzhi pa mtshams gcod srung 'khor ni/ hūm̐: bdag nyid zhe sdang rdo rje yi: spyan mig nyi zla 'bar zhing sreg: thugs las khro ba'i tshwa tshwa 'phro: stong gsum sprul pa'i me yis 'gengs: phyogs mtshams mtshon cha 'chol bas gtams: bdag med stong par mtshams bcad do: sur+ya tsan+d+ra badz+ra kro dha dz+wa la raṃ raṃ tsakra warti ma hā kro dha sarba duṣ+ṭan e hūm̐ phaṭa: lnga pa skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ hūm̐ hrī: chos sku'i ston pa sangs rgyas 'od dpag med: sogs nas/ bar chad bdud sde'i g.yul las bskyab tu gsol: lan gsum drug po sems bskyed ni/ ho: ma dad 110)gdul bar bya ba'i tshul bstan te: bla med byang chub gnas su 'god par bya'o: lan gsum bdun pa tshogs gsog ni/ ho: rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal:

dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo: mchog gsum brten pa'i zhing gyur la: gnyis med yid kyis skyabs su mchi: dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i: dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol: dngos grub chu bo gcod pa'i bgegs: nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi: phyogs bcu 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos: ma chags spyod la rjes yi rang: dag pa'i mtha' bzhi dri ma med: rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do: bde gshegs dbang phyug sems dpa' la: dgos pa gsum phyir lus 'bul lo: tshe rabs bgrangs ba'i las rnams kun: bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo: lan gsum/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ 111) brgyad pa dam bca' bzung ba ni/ ho: ma rig rlabs kyis sems nyid rang zhal sgrib: sogs nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra sa ma ya ho: dgu pa snod bcud byin 'bebs ni/ hūm̐: dpal chen rdo rje gro bo lod: sogs nas/ hring hringaḥsarba sid+dhi hūm̐: bcu pa byin rlabs ni/ hūm̐: dbyings nas yi ge 'bru gsum char du babs: mchod rdzas nyes skyon ma dag bsregs gtor bkrus: bh+ruṃ las rin chen a las bhan+dha'i nang: phyi nang gsang gsum mchod spyin rgya mtshor gyur: oṃ badz+ra pu ṣ+pe dhu ba pe di pam̐ ghan+dhe ru pa shap+da ghan+dhe rā sa spar+she/ spar+she sarba pū dza āḥhūm̐: sman gtor rak+ta sngags kyis brlab/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭha: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā ba ling ta te dz+wa bha ling ta bha la bha te gu h+ya sa ma ye swa hā: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rak+ta sa man+ta maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ phaṭa: gnyisapa dngos gzhi 112) la yang gnyis/ / stod las dang ni smad las so: /dang po bskyed bzlas yan lag gsum// bskyed par rnam grangs bcu gsum las: de bzhin nyid kyi ting 'dzin ni/ hūm̐: rnam par mi rtog ye nas skye med cing: sogs nas/ dzñā na at+ma ko3 haṃ: gnyis pa kun snang ting 'dzin ni/ ma ltar byams pa kun la khyab pa'i sku:

sogs nas/ r+dharmā r+dhartu hūm̐: gsum pa rgyu yi ting 'dzin ni/ yi ge hūm̐ ni sems kyi rang bzhin te: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bzhi pa rten dang brten bskyed ni/ hūm̐ las zhe sdang 'bar ba'i nam mkha' la: sogs nas/ gdod nas lhun grub dkyil 'khor chen por shar: lnga pa byin brlabs dbang bskur ni/ thugs sgrub dpal chan 'dus pa las/ hūm̐: rang las shar ba'i dpal chen tshogs: mthu rtsal yongs su rjogs bya'i phyir: sku gsung thugs su byin brlab cing: ye shes lnga ru dbang bskur ro: oṃ ā:hūm̐: oṃ hūm̐ swa aṃ hā: rang gi spyi bor zla ba la oṃ: mgrin par pad+ma la āḥ snying gar nyi ma la hūm̐ḥgis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros: 113) de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs: yi ge gsum la thim: de yongs su gyur pa las: sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje'i ngo bor rnam pa nyi shus byang chub pa'i lha: spyi bor rnam snang dkar po 'khor lo 'dzin pa: mgrin par snang mtha' dmar po pad+ma 'dzin pa: thugs kar mi bskyod pa sngon po rdo rje 'dzin pas rgyas btab pas gzhi lam 'bras bu'i yon tan yongs su rdzogs par gyur: rdo rje rtse lnga gsum pa dang*// gcig pa'i phyag rgya gnas gsum gtugs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā ka ya badz+ra swa bha wa ad+makony+rahaṃ: de bzhin waka dang*/ tsit+ta sbyar/ slar yang spyi po'i gnas so sor// rigs lnga'i dbang rgya bca' bzhin du/ oṃ ma hā pra t+ya bek+ṣa ṇa dzñā na badz+ra swa bha wa ad+ma kony+ra haṃ: de bzhin du/ oṃ ma hā a dar+sha: oṃ ma hā sa man+ta: oṃ ma hā shu n+ya ta: oṃ ma hā kṛ t+ya nuṣ+ṭha na dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa ad+ma kony+ra haṃ: spyi bo'i gnas 114) lngar dbang lha yab yum rjes chags rgyas pa'i zhu bde'i chu rgyun byang chub sems kyi rol pas dbang bskur: nyon mongs pa lnga'i dri ma sbyangs: phung po lnga rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas su gnas 'gyur bas kun brtags la gzhan dbang gis rgyas btab:

chu lhag spyi bor lud pa las: gzhan dbang la yongs grub kyis rgyas thebs shing ye shes 'gyur ba med pa'i brdar dbu gtsug na rdo rje phyed pa dang: rigs bdag snang ba mtha' yas kyis dbu brgyan par gyur: rang gi 'dun pa sems dpa' dang: snying ga'i 'od kyi rol pa chen pos phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad nam mkha' gang ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo badz+ra sa mā dza: snyan bsan drug pa spyan 'dren ni// spos dang rol mo dbyangs dang bcas/ ham̐'u: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: sogs nas/ gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: bdun pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ bde chen chos sku brdal ba'i zhing khams su: sogs nas/ a we sha ya ā: brgyad pa phyag gi mchod pa ni/ 'dod 115) chags dag pas shes rab pha rol phyin: sogs nas / shrī na ma: dgu pa kun bzang bzhi bsnol mchod/ kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin phung chen por shar: sogs nas/ na maḥsarba ta tha ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba te khaṃ uṅga te s+pha na i maṃ gag na khaṃ swa hā: puṣ+pe dhu pe a lo ke ghan+dhe nai wi d+ya shab+da pra tits+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ swa hā: bcu pa 'dod yon drug gis mchod/ 'dod yon rang 'phrul rdo rje'i dam tshig ste: sogs nas/ rā sa par+she dharma ho: bcu gcig khyad par mchog gis mchod/ dgyes mnyam mchog gi mchod pa chen po 'di: sogs nas/ sa ma ya a ra li khā hi: bcu gnyis yon tan rjes dran bstod/ ma bcos spros bral bla ma chos kyi sku: sogs nas/ dpal gyi bka' nyan skyong ma bzhi la bstod: bcu gsum dam tshig nyams chags bshags/ bdag cag sems can las kyis mnar zhing gzir: sogs nas/ ye shes gzigs mnga' 'phags pa'i tshogs la bshags: yig brgya brjod/ bskyed pa lha yi rnal 'byor ro/ gnyis par rnam grangs bcu 116) gcig las/ dang po bzlas pa'i dmigs pa ni/ phaṭa dza: sa bdag mdun so sor phye/ bdag mdun thugs kar rin chen zur brgyad dbus:

gser kyi rde rje rtse lnga'i lte ba la: pad+ma nyi ma zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la: rang byung rig pa hūm̐ yig dmar po'i mthar: rtsa ba'i rigs sngags bye ru'i phreng ba bzhin: gnyis pa rta mchog rol pa'i sngags/ o pad+man+ta kri ta h+ya gh+ri wa hūm̐: bsnyen sngags 'bum phrag bzhi ru bzla// gsum pa rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra shri gro bo lod sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: sgrub khang grangs bsnyen 'bru 'bum la/ mtshan ma rtags mthong dus bzang drug /bzhi pa spro bsdu'i ting nge 'dzin/ 'od zer lcags kyi tshwa tshwa gtams pa'am: 'gal me dmar po klad la bskor ba bzhin: 'khor zhing snang bas bde gshegs zhing khams 'gengs: sgra dang 'od kyis rgyud bskul mchod sprin spros: slar yang ngan song gnas sbyangs rgyud lnga bsgral: kun kyang dpal chen khro bo'i zhing du gyur: gzung 'dzin rtog bral byang chub sems kyi ngang: gdan gsum yongs rdzogs chos sku'i rol par blta: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: 117) zhes bzla 'od gsal dgongs pa skyong*/ lnga pa bsrung ba'i rdzong chen bca'/ gtso bo'i thugs srog gi klad kor du bla ma: ha'i khog par bsrung bya:zhabs dkyur yul mkhar nor phyugs: thugs srog las 'od zer 'phros: de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul: mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi yon tan 'od zer ser po'i rnam par bsdus pa gtsug tor 'khor lo sgyur ba'i ngo bo nyid rdo rje'i rdul phra rab tu gyur pas srung byed rdo rje'i gur la thim pas rdo rje'i bzhu lugs su gyur pas cis kyang mi tshugs par sgom la/ oṃ badz+ra shri gro bo lod sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: oṃ āḥ ash+ṇi ṣa badz+ra tsakra warti bh+ruṃ sarba lo ki swa hā: zhes pa stong phrag tsam du bzla/ drug pa zlog pa'i 'khrul 'khor bshams/ byad ma stobs 'joms dmigs pa ni/ hūm̐: bsrung 'khor gsal brtan 'bar ba yi: thugs ka'i hūm̐ las hūṃ 'phros phyir:

stong gsum 'jig rten hūm̐ gis gang: byad gdon stongs 118) shing za par bsgral: slar 'dus rdo rje'i rwa ba'i phyir: ye shes me dang gnyis med klong: yongs gyur gnam lcags 'khor lo ni: rtsibs stong 'bar ba'i rno dbal la: byad phur rbod gtong sri keg dang: gnod byed dgra gdon log 'dren tshogs: so so'i gzugs dang byad dbyibs lngar: rang dbang med par bkug byas nas: spu gri reg gcod 'thor rlung gis: 'khor lo g.yon du bskor ba yis: gzugs phung thal ba'i rdul du rlog: sngags phreng las byung me stag gis: lhag ma rjes shul med par sreg: rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su phaṭa: rtsa sngags gsham bur/ oṃ lok+t+ri pā la nan: sa ga pa sha nan: nā ga du du nan: ma maṃ ma maṃ: tsir tsar tsir tsar: baṃ ru lu baṃ ru lu: rbad tra ko sha ya rbad tra ko sha ya: ho ra ho ra: tsi du sod rtsi du sod: shig lhu ru gtubs: ha la pa ti nan: 'khor ba dul: gnod byed che ge mo ka wa tsi 119) brlag brlag: trig nan myag thum ha na da ha pa tsa mug mug thib thib hed hed bh+yo zlog phaṭa: zhes bzlas bden stobs brjod pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyis ni bdud pham mdzad: chos ma yin pa chos kyis so: dge 'dun gyis ni mu stegs pham: dbang pos lha rnams rab tu pham: lha min rnams kyis zla ba pham: nam mkha' lding gis rgya mtsho yi: klu rnams rab tu pham par gyur: me yis bud shing sreg pa dang: rlung gis sprin rnams gtor ba dang: rdo rjes rin chen phug pa dang: lha rnams bden pas rab tu gnas: bden pa 'di dag thams cad kyis: deng 'dir bden pa 'grub gyur cig: ces brjod thal rdeb lan gsum bya// mun pa bsad pa'i thog chen 'bebs/ gzhung las/ rdo rje'i tshwa tshwas ldan dgra'i klad snying 'gem: zhes dang*/ lcags sdig nag po ser chen bzhin du 'bebs// zhes pa'i dgongs pa gsal 'debs ni/ sku dang phyag mtshan thams cad las: gnam lcags rdo rje'i tshwa tshwa dang:

lcags sdig nag po 120) ser chen bzhin: babs pas stong khams thams cad khengs: pha rol byad phur dmag tshogs dang: sde brgyad log 'dren thal bar rlog: 'khor 'das byang chub sems kyi klong: gnyis snang dgra 'dre dbyings su yal: rtsa sngags gsham du/ oṃ badz+ra rak+sha rwa tsa'i tsit+ta zung: kha rag sbe sha rak+sha ra tsa'i tsit+ta rbad: 'khu na dum bu rā tsa'i tsit+ta shig: 'da' na rak+sha ra tsa'i tsit+ta phyung: ldog na rak+sha ra tsa'i tsit+ta rbad: tri'u gtub gtub rbad rbad: tsit+ta hu lu hu lu rbad: tsit+ta rak+sha gtub gtub: tri'u du tri'u du: badz+ra sarba du ṣ+ṭi trig na hur thuṃ dzaḥmā ra ya rbad: ces pa'i las sngags khri phrag gcig /thun rdzas la yang sngags kyis btab// brgyad pa sngags kyi nus pa gso// dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying rnams// lan gsum dgu pa mchod sprin spro// mchod phreng dri za'i rgyud mang ngam// las byang gzhung las byung bas mchod// bcu pa bstod pa phrin las ltar// bcu gcig yig brgyas nongs pa bshags// bzlas pa sngags kyi rnal 'byor ro// gsum pa bsod nams spel

121) la brgyad// dang po rgyab dpung bskyed pa'i phyir// bka' gter srung ma'i phrin las btang: gnyis pa tshogs rdzas sbyangs rtogs sbar/ bkra shis mtshan ldan rdo rje ka pa la: sogs nas/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gsum pa tshogs zhing spyan drangs pa/ oṃ bde bar gshegs pa bcom ldan 'das: sogs nas/ shrī badz+ra aṅku sha dza: shrī badz+ra pa sha ham̐'u: shrī badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ: shrī badz+ra ghan+ḍe ho: bzhi pa yul bzhi'i lha mos mchod/ ho: dung mdog sgeg mo rdo rje'i spyan: sogs nas/ shrī badz+ra lā s+ya hūṃ: shrī badz+ra ma le traṃ: shrī badz+ra garti hrī: shrī badz+ra nirti ā: lnga pa dus bzhi'i lha mos mchod/ spos kyi sprin lding bdug pa mo: sogs nas/ shrī badz+ra dhu pe dhu: shrī badz+ra puṣ+pe pu: shrī badz+ra a lo ke hrī: shrī badz+ra ghan+dhe ghan: drug pa 'dod yon lnga yis mchod/ gzugs su snang ba thams cad kun: sogs nas/ shrī badz+ra ru pa oṃ: shrī badz+ra shab+da hūm̐: shrī badz+ra ghan+dhe traṃ: shrī badz+ra ra sa hrī: shrī badz+ra par+she āḥ bdun pa tshogs phud dang po ni/ tshogs rje tshogs bdag dbang dang ldan: sogs nas/ lha rnams 122) mnyes shing dngos grub 'bebs: brgyad pa bar pa bshags pa ni / ho: dbang chen rdo rje gro lod dgongs su gsol: sogs nas/ dag tshangs mchog gi dngos grub stsal du gsol: yig brgya brjod/ stod las rnal 'byor sgrub pa'o/ gnyis pa mngon spyod las sbyor la/ bco lnga'i dang po thugs dam skul/ hūm̐ bh+yo: bde chen chos dbyings sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i sku: sogs nas/ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐: gnyis pa lha srung skyems gyis brngan/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ gser skyems zag pa med pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsa'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rig 'dzin rtsa rgyud bla ma dam pa dang*// bde gshegs kun 'dus zhi khro rab 'byams lha/ khyad par dbang drag pad+ma'i lha tshogs rnams// gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed// ma mgon lcam dral tshe ring mched lnga dang*// dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu yab yum bran// bka' nyan bran g.yog mngag gzhug bcas pa

123) rnams// gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed// sngags 'chang bdag gi rigs kyi srung ma dang*// sa phyogs 'di yi yul gzhi gnas kyi bdag /lo zla zhag dus tshes la dbang ba'i lha// gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed/ gsum pa bden rdzun drang shan 'byed/ hūm̐ bh+yo: ma nyes ma lan 'phags pa'i tshogs: sogs nas/ drang srong dmod pa'i bka' chad thongs: bzhi pa dmigs rten 'bel (?) du bzung*/ e raṃ phaṭa raṃ dz+wa la raṃ: eḥngo mtshar bsad pa'i da la ni: sogs nas/ mi sdug nyams thag gzas po gsal: lnga pa bden pas dgug pa ni/ na mo/ rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi= chos kyi= dge 'dun gyi= gsang sngags rigs sngags gzungs sngags dang snying po dang phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin gyi bden pa dang*/ chos nyid gdod nas stongs kyang chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med 124) pa'i bden pa dang*/ khyad par du che mchog pad+ma drag po dbang chen rdo rje grobo lod kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs bka' sdod pho nya'i dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis bden pa chen po'i mthu la brten nas bstan dang 'gro ba'i spyi dgra/ khyad par rig pa 'dzin pa bdag cag yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la/ snga dgra lag gis brdar ba/ phyi dgra yid la bsam pa/ da dgra thad du 'dzugs pa'i gzugs can sdang ba'i dgra dang*/ gzugs med gnod byed bgegs kyi tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad srid pa gsum gyi khongs gar gnas gar bros kyang skad cig yud tsam la dmigs pa'i rten 'di la khug cig rtsa sngags thar/ nṛ tri badz+ra aṅgu sha dza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: lan gsum drug pa pho nya spro/ hūm̐ dzaḥstobs bcu mnga' ba rdo rje gro bo lod: sogs nas*/ bla sha re ma ti 'grim: sogs/ bdun pa skyobs byed lha dang dbye/ bh+yo: las byed phra men phra ma mkhan:

sogs nas/ 125) bha yaṃ shag phyes: bdun pa drang srong dmod pas sgrol: hūm̐: dpal chen gsang ba'i bka' las ni: sogs nas/ hur thuṃ dzaḥmā ra ya rbad: ces pas thun rdzas sna tshogs dbab/ khyad par phur bus snying khar gzir// gzas po'i tshe bsod 'od dkar po// phur rtses blangs la rang la bstim// phur pa las byung ye shes mes// rigs drug sa bon bsregs shing sbyangs// rnam shes a yig he ru ka'i// thugs kyi klong du spar ba ste// dgongs pa gsum gyis gdab par bya// snyigs ma ral gris dum bur gtubs// brgyad pa zhal du stob pa ni/ hūm̐: dbang chen rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: sogs nas/ ma hā zhing chen la khā hi: dgu pa thugs dam skong ba ni// skong bshags rdo rje'i thol glu btang*// bcu pa tshogs la rol ba ni:/ ho: tshogs kyi mchod pa rgyan du rol: a la la ho: zhes drangs bsam pa lhun grub rjes/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus pad+ma thod phreng gis// bdag sogs rjes bzung tshe rabs thams cad du// 'gal rkyen kun zhi bsam don lhun grub nas// mthar thug pad+ma 'od du skye bar shog bcu gcig lhag ma btang ba ni/ 126) kyai: dang po phud kyis mi mchod rgyu: dpal chen dkyil 'khor tshogs kyis bdag: bar du bshags pa mi bgyid rgyu: rnal 'byor ldan la dam tshig gnyan: tha ma bsgral stab mi bgyid rgyu: rtogs pas bdag rgyud sngon sgrol phyir: da lta lhag mas mi mchod rgyu: ma tshogs dbang phyug ging lang ka: pho nya sum brgya drug cu sogs: kun kyang dpal chen sprul pa yin: lhag ma kha chus mi bran rgyu: dam tshig gcig tu bsre ba'i phyir: 'bangs thog rje yis mi mnan rgyu: ci bcol las la bskul ba'i phyir: rje la 'bangs kyis mi rgol rgyu: drag shul las thabs myur ba'i phyir: he ru ka'i dam rgyas kha phru dbab/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ ha ho hrī: lhag ma'i dam tshig 'dod yon gyi phung po zad mi shes pas nam mkha' gang bar gyur:

127) e a ral+li pheṃ pheṃ dza: badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs kyis mchod/ hūm̐: rnam dag rang bzhin zhi ba las: bcom ldan dpal chen sprul pa ni: thabs shes zla gsang rol pa las: dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong ba ste: khyed cag sngon gyi yal gam can: lag na glo snying nang khrol thogs: legs nyes stangs 'dzin tshogs khang nyul: mthu dang rdzu 'phrul dpag tu med: sngon tshe dpal chen he ru kas: dug gsum ru tra bsgral ba'i tshe: khas blangs dam bca' dran gyis la: srin mo'i za lam chen po ru: pham phabs long la bstan pa srungs: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: bcu gnyis bzlog pa'i phrin las la// ling ro gtor chung sman raka sbran/ hūm̐ bh+yo: 'og min gsang chen rol pa'i zhing khams nas: sogs kyis 'gres bya dang po gnyis// gzhung ltar sbyar nas gsum pa la/ hūm̐ bh+yo: chos dbyings ye shes dag gangs can mtsho: rdo rje slob dpon bud+dha thod phreng rtsal: 128) ma dad sems can chen po bsgral byas nas: zhes sogs 'gres byang gong ltar sbyar/ hūm̐ bh+yo: me long ye shes rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: ma dad sems can chen po bsgral byas nas: sogs nas/ hūm̐ bh+yo: mnyam nyid ye shes rat+na thod phreng rtsal: ma dad sems can chen po bsgral byas nas: sogs nas/ ham̐'u bh+yo: sor rtog ye shes pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: ma dad sems can chen po bsgral byas nas: sogs nas/ hūm̐ bh+yo: bya grub ye shes karma thod phreng rtsal: ma dad sems can chen po bsgral byas nas: sogs nas/ hūm̐ bh+yo: rigs bzhi'i ging chen mkha' 'gro'i 'khor dang bcas: ma dad sems can chen po bsgral byas nas: sogs nas/ hūm̐ bh+yo: phrin las bzhi sgrub dbang phyug sgo ma'i tshogs: ma dad sems can chen po bsgral byas nas: zhes sogs sbyar ba'i 'gres dgu ma/ lan gcig song rjes 'gros gsum ma// gzhung ltar tshar gra ngas bsags pa'i mthar// bcu gnyis bzlog 'phyang gyer ba ni// rol pa chen po'i gtor zlog las/

hūm̐: zlog byed dbang drag rol pa'i lha: zlog sgyur las mdzad dus la 129) bab: bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag la: sngon las 'phral rkyen bar chad bgegs: 'jigs pa brgyad dang bcu drug sogs: bkra mi shis pa'i dngos po dang: phyi nang drang srong dmod pa'i mtshon: ban bon mu stegs rigs sngags byad: gshin rje'i 'khor lo ma mo'i khram: phur pa'i dbal kha bon po'i btso: kla klo'i g.yul dang ngan sngags sbyar: lha srin khros dang gdon chen zug: sdeb gshor hom dang thun zor mnan: gtad khram rbod gtong rbad dre dang: mi kha gleng gzhi 'thab rtsod mchu: keg sri than ltas ngan pa kun: bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bo dang: yongs la gnod pa'i bgegs gdon sogs: bsam sbyor ngan pa'i steng du bh+yo: zlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: sgyur ro za kha dgra la sgyur: zlog sgyur bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod: bcu bzhi bzlog sngags gong bzhin dang*// bden stobs bcas pas thal mo rdeb// bco lnga thun gtor la dmigs te/ 130) / 'gugs gzhug rjes su byin rlabs ni/ dam nyams dgra bgegs bsgral ba las byung ba'i: zhes sogs mnan pa'i gzhung ltar rjes/ rtsa sngags gtor sngags btags pas 'bul/ de nyid zor du skul pa ni/ dzaḥbh+yo rbad bh+yo: bh+yo: do nub drag po sngags kyis byin brlabs pa: sogs nas/ e sa bh+yo bzlog rbad ya: gsum pa rgyun gyi rjes chog la// rnam grangs bcu gsum dang po la// chos skyong rgyun gtor spyi ltar bskyang*// gnyis pa thugs dam skul ba ni/ hūm̐ bh+yo: bden chen chos dbyings sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i sku: zhes sogs gzhung las 'byung ba dang*// gsum pa chad tho sgrog pa ni/ hūm̐: sngon tshe 'das dus bskal pa'i dang po la: sogs nas/ rak+sha si: zhes pa'i bar/ bzhi pa brtan ma skyong ba ni/ bh+yo: tshogs dang bka' yi bdag nyid ni: khrag 'thung rdo rje nam mkha'i yum: gangs ri can gyi yul lha ni:

bdud dang gnod sbyin sman mo bzhi: tshur spyon tshur spyon gtor ma longs: rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis dang: dus sbyor bcu gnyis gnas dag pa: bal bod mtshams na tshe ring ma: la stod rdo rje g.ya' ma skyong: 131) gnod sbyin gangs la kun bzang mo: 'brog chen 'khor 'dul bgegs kyi gtso: jo mo gangs dkar spyan gcig ma: byang na mkha' lding klu mo rgyal: kha rag rdo rje khyung btsun ma: rma chen spom rar drag mo rgyal: kong btsun de mo bod khams skyong: 'brog chen rdo rje sman gcig ma: jo mo nags rgyal g.yar mo bsil: dbus na rdo rje zu le sman: kun kyang pad+ma'i bka' nyan te: dam la gnas shing rigs la 'go: tha tshig bzhin du gtor ma longs: mtha' yi dmag dang rgya 'dre'i 'tshub: mu stegs 'gyu ba'i sgo 'phrang dang: 'gong po spun dgu'i nad dal srungs: rtag chad thar par 'khrul pa yi: 'jig tshogs lta ba dbu mar zlog: bden don rnam pa bcu gnyis kyi: bstan pa dar ba'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ la la: taṃ taṃ: te te: kha rak+ma: ma ma sring 'gro ma hūṃ bh+yo hūm̐ hūm̐: lnga pa rdo rje'i bro 132) yis gzir/ hūm̐: e yi dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir: zhes pa nas/ ha ha ru lu hūm̐ phaṭa: bar ro/ drug pa mchod pa gong ltar ram/ oṃ shri badz+ra kro dha ma hā sh+ma sha na puṣ+paṃ dhu dī paṃ ghan+dhaṃ rū pa shab+da ghan+dhe rā sa par+she dha pañtsa rak+ta ba ling+ta khā hi: bdun pa bstod pa gzhung ltar ram/ bai ḍūr sngon mo rin chen ri rab dbus: nyi ma stong gi 'od zer 'bar ba ltar: sems dpa' sngon po 'od kyi dkyil 'khor can: dpal ldan gzi brjid 'bar la phyag 'tshal bstod: 'od dpung stug po sprin ltar 'thibs pa yi: 'jigs byed rngam stabs rkyang bskum tshul du bzhugs: za byed bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba yis: gdug pa zhal du 'dren la phyag 'tshal bstod: mi bzad mche bas brgyan pa'i zhal gdangs shing: khams gsum za bar byed pa'i rkan sgra can:

nyi zla 'bar ba'i spyan gyi sdang mig gis: bgegs dpung sreg par mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod: brgyad pa nongs pa bshags pa ni/ bdag cag sems can las kyis 133) mnar zhing gzir: ma rig las kyis smin po rgyud lngar 'khyams: log rtog ngan pa'i dbang bsgyur 'gal 'khrul rnams: ye shes gzigs mnga' 'phags pa'i tshogs la bshags: yig brgya lan gsum dgu pa ni/ brtan bzhugs/ 'dir ni gzugs= sogs brjod/ bcu pa rtag pa'i mtha' bsal ba/ hūm̐: ngo mtshar sprul pa'i 'khor lo ma lus pa: sogs dang*/ a a aḥ bcu gcig chad pa'i mtha' bsal ba/ slar yang khams gsum nas/ gar mdzod cig: bcu gnyis bsngo ba smon lam ni/ ho: lha mchog bsnyen cing= sogs dang*/ don rtogs shog: zhes pa'i zar brjod/ bcu gnyis bkra shis brjod pa ni/ 'chi med zla gam= sogs brjod/ bde legs stsol: spyi don gsum pa rjes kyi las// bcu dgu'i dang po zer rdzas sgrub// grol nyin bzlog 'phyang rdzogs pa dang*// gong ltar mchod bstod nongs bshags/ ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar btegs: dam tshig pa bdag la thim par gyur: slar yang gtor chen zor rdzas dang bcas pa skad cig gis 'chol ba'i khro rgyal chen po dregs pa lha srin sde brgyad kyi dmag 134) tshogs khro gtum 'jigs pa'i gzugs can srid gsum gang ba nad mtshon dug gi char 'bebs pas dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i las la rngam par gyur: rtsa ba'i sngags dang lok+t+ri'i gsham/ trig nan myags thum ha nad ha pa tsa mug mug thib thib hed hed bh+yo zlog phaṭa: zor ma ra ya zor ya: e sa bh+yo zlog rbad ya: ces pa zor rdzas rno ngar skyed// bden stobs gong ltar thal mo rdeb// gnyis pa thun gtor 'gugs pa dang*// dmag ltor stob tshul mnan pa bzhin// shes rab snying pos bdud bzlog bya// gsum pa sgo dbye rgab dkris bya// rdul tshon dkar pos zor lam gtod/ hūm̐: dbang drag rol pa'i dkyil 'khor na:

phyag rgya bzhi ldan sgo srung rnams: thugs rje'i thabs kyi phyag rgya dang: stong nyid shes rab dgongs pa yis: pho brang rnams kyi sgo phyes shig: dbang chen rol pa'i lha tshogs rnams: dbyings la rtsol rtog mi mnga' yang: byams pa chen pas gdul dka' rnams: snying rje'i mthu yis sgrol ba'i phyir: dga' ba chen po'i gar 135) dgu'i nyams: btang snyoms chen po'i klong nas skyod: skyod dang skyod byed mi mnga' yang: dmar chen gtor ma chen po dang: gnyis med rol pa'i dmag dpung 'di: brgya byin g.yul ngor chas pa 'dra: ri rab dag kyang mgo mjug ldog: rgya mtsho 'chol ba'i skar tshogs 'khrugs: lha min mgo bo 'gas byed na: sdang ba'i dgra la smos ci 'tshal: de phyir pho brang sgo phyes la: shul la ma dgra bo'i phyogs su ston: zlog sgyur phrin las dus la bab: bzhi pa thugs dam skul pa dang*// lnga pa chad tho gzhung ltar gtong*// drug pa gom pa brgyad cu'i mtshams/ gtor tshugs steng du thugs dam skul// lam sel brngan sbyin gser skyems dang*// dkar gtor dmar gtor gnyis kyang btegs/

hūm̐: phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad steng 'og bcur: gnas pa'i che rgu gnyen rgu rnams: dbang phyug nga yi zor lam la: ru nga phrag dog ma mdzad cig: steng gi nyi 136) zla sgra gcan nas: steng na bzhugs pa zhabs bsdus shig: brngan du dkar gtor gser skyems 'bul: bar na bzhugs pa logs su byol: brngan du g.yu sngon phud skyems bran: 'og na bzhugs pa dbu chum zhig: brngan du dmar gtor gser skyems 'bul: bdag gi zor sna gnyan po'i lam: phyogs rnams rang bzhin med pa'i dbyings: brgyud nas dam nyams dgra bo dang: rgyal ba'i bka' la mi nyan pa'i: 'byung po'i tshogs la 'phen pa'i phyir: las kyi sdong grogs gnyen po mdzod: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: gtor ma 'bul zhing gser skyems gtor// bdun pa drag po'i theb dang bstun/ gang du 'phang ba'i sar phyin la// thugs dam bskul pa gong ltar btang*// brgyad pa rig 'dzin rtsa rgyud ma'i// gser skyems srid pa'i dkar gtor ni/ ho/ lo rgyal po/ zla ba blon po/ zhag dmag dus tshod mtshon cha/ srid pa gsum gyi yab yum gnam sa/ g.yas gangs 137) ri dkar po skyes pa pho y-i bla ri: g.yon sribs ri nag po za ma mo yi bla ri/ mtshams bzhi bu tsha nor gyis bsdus pa'i yul 'dir gnas pa'i/ klu gnyan sa bdag bsen mo/ shar phyogs 'byung ba shing gi lha/ lho phyogs 'byung ba me yi lha: nub phyogs 'byung ba lcags kyi lha/ byang phyogs 'byung ba chu yi lha/ mtshams bzhi 'byung ba sa yi lha/ shar gyi stag skya bo/ lho'i g.yu 'brug sngon mo/ nub kyi bya dmar po/ byang gi rus sbal nag po/ dbus kyi spre'u ser po/ mtshams bzhi g.yog brgyad dmangs kyi lha/ the se rgyal po la sogs te lo yi sa bdag 'brug lha gwa pa la sogs te zla ba'i sa bdag gser mdzod ser mo la sogs te zhag gi sa bdag g.yu mdzod sngon mo la sogs dus tshod kyi sa bdag shing pho byi ba la sogs te lo drug cu'i lha mo/

lhag 138) la sogs te zla ba'i lha/ sa stag la sogs te zhag gi lha/ lcags yos la sogs te dus tshod kyi lha/ lo zla dus bzhi'i sa bdag spar kha brgyad kyi lha/ sme ba dgu'i lha/ gza' skar 'phrod sbyor dus lha 'byung po'i lha/ phyed gnyis dang zer gnyis su rgyu ba'i lha/ gnyug mar gnas pa'i lha la sogs pa yul dus la dbang byed pa'i sa bdag lha klu 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la rang gi spyod yul dang mthun pa'i gtor ma rgyan ldan g.yos su sbyar ba gser skyems kyis brgyan pa'i mchod pa dam pa 'dis gsol zhing mchod do/ so so'i rgyud tshims pa dang longs spyod kyi rkyen du 'byur bar gyur cig bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la che bas ma bkyon/ chung bas ma 'khang*/ ru nga dang phrag dog ma mdzad/ bdag ni sa dang dus la dbang mi byed do/ sa dang yul dus kyi bdag po khyed rnams la 139) brten nas las dang bya ba byed pa yin pas sdong grogs mdzod cig bkra shis dang bde legs phun sum tshogs par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod dkar gtor gser skyems 'bul// dgu pa dgra bo'i yul mkhar zhing*// mi nor kha rje dbang thang bcas/ hom du dgug gzhug byas pa la// bya gcan gzan la rbad pa bzhin// zor rdzas dug mtshon dmag dpung bsgul/ hūm̐: dbang chen rol pa'i pho nya rnams: mig nas khrag gi tshwa tshwa 'phro: kha na bh+yo zlog phaṭaḥsgra sgrogs: ral pa sprugs pa'i skra gseb nas: khro chu khol ma'i skyin thang 'bebs: rkang lag lcags kyi sder mo yis: gnam sa med par sbar gyis 'debs: ri rlung med par rjes kyis 'gengs: zas su sems can gson po za: brnag pa'i gnas su yud kyis phyin: gang la bya ba'i dgra bgegs gnyis: ma thogs myur du khrid la shog: dang po zhe sdang pha yis bskyed: bar du 'dod chags ma yi 140) mngal: de nas dri za nye bar 'khor: tha ma nyon mongs dug lnga'i rten: phung po khams dang skye mched dang:

tshogs brgyad rtsad nas gcod pa'i phyir: ༈ klad pa'i dkyil du rdo zor ya: ༈ nyan pa'i rna bar mtshe zor ya: ༈ lta ba'i mig la mda' zor ya: ༈ snom pa'i sna la khrag zor ya: smra ba'i lce la phur zor ya: ༈ dran pa'i snying la dug zor ya: ༈ 'gro ba'i rkang la mtshon zor ya: ༈ yul mkhar khyim la me zor ya: ༈ nor gyi dbyig la sgong zor ya: ༈ 'og gi rta la rtsang zor ya: ༈ mchan gyi bu la yungs zor ya: ༈ rabs chad dud pas skye rgyud chod: ri rgyud phung pas yul mkhar bsgyel: kong zor 'bar bas chom la phob: tshon skud sna lngas byad du chugs: tsher ma'i shing gis gnod gdug slongs: mda' khras skyes pa gri 'thab sbyor: 'phang khras 141) bud med dug sbyor g.yos: lcags zangs dug khrag myos su chugs: khram shing gshin rje'i kha ru rdzongs: lo zla zhag du ma 'gyangs par: ming tsam med par phung du chugs: tsit+ta ku lu nan: tsakra raṃ: shag shag raṃ: khā hi raṃ: su tri ni: dza tri dza: ya ya: zor cha bcu bzhi so sor yang*// sbyar ba kun bzang gzhan phan lugs// bcu pa zlog 'phyang gong ltar gyer// bcu gcig zor chen 'phang ba ni// slar yang 'gugs pa dang bcas pas/ dzaḥbh+yo rbad: bh+yo: do nub drag po sngags kyis byin brlabs pa: zhes sogs brjod nas gtor chen rbud: /bcu gnyis me chus mtshams bcad la// srung ba'i 'khor lo gong bzhin sgoms/ rdo rje slob dpon rting mnan ldog: bcu gsum tsam sgo drung bar gtor bshams: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gis byin gyis rlobs/ bh+yo: tshogs dang bka' yi= sogs kyis 'bul// bcu bzhi dong du ling ga brub// 'gug gzhug dang bcas bro yis mnan/ hūm̐: e yi dkyil 'khor =la sogs brjod// bco lnga gtor gzhong nang du 'bru// gtor zhing 'chi med zla gam bsngo// shis pa brjod cing nang du log /bcu drug 'chi med tshe 'gugs la: 142) rig 'dzin tshe sgrub bzhin du bya// bcu bdun dngos grub blang ni/

hūm̐ hrī: bh+ruṃ skyes gtor ma lha yi gzhal yas khang: sogs nas/ sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: bco brgyad rdo rje'i chos srung la// gtang rag gtor 'bul phrin las gsol// bcu dgu rjes chog mchod bstod man// gong bzhin mtha' rgyas legs par bya/ baiḍūr sa 'dzin snang byed 'bum 'khyud lta'i// che ba'i che mchog drag shul 'bum phrag dbal// bstan 'gror 'tshe byed 'bum la bsnyil ba yis// ming med brlags ste bde skyid 'bum brdal shog zhes pa kun mkhyen bla mas rjes su gnang ba bzhin du dpal chen 'dus pas zhal bskangs ste bsdebs pa dge legs 'phel// dge'o//
